floor.description: Shared floor: rules and entity blocks no per-app pack can loosen.

t1_evidence.description: Deterministic minimum evidence for any T1 (security-reducing) action, whatever the re-check model says. core_facts must be known; when a source lists costly_support, at least one of those conditions must hold (facts an attacker cannot buy cheaply for a fresh campaign). At least one cited typed fact must meet a benign_support condition. Sender history stops counting as costly support when any costly_negated_by fact is true (a known sender behaving unusually: how a compromised account looks).

sequence.description: Actions already executed on the same alert (not reverted) inside window_s. One security-reducing action per alert runs automatically; a chain such as whitelist then close then suppress needs a human.
